why_ai: Clients pay for a specific trainer's in-person coaching, cueing and accountability; certification is not licensure.
why_clarity: Weekly sessions recur and progress is measurable, but programming varies by trainer and client.
why_digital: Work starts from a client's body and is delivered face to face to local clients.

why_ai: Hands-on assistance and individual assessment of disabled clients need intensive human contact and rapport.
why_clarity: Every client's impairment differs, so programming is adapted case by case with slow progress.
why_digital: Physical training of bodies delivered in person, bought locally.

why_ai: Accredited credentials gyms require gain value as AI floods unverified fitness advice.
why_clarity: Psychometric exam development follows codified standards and validates on candidate response data.
why_digital: Item banks and curricula online, with proctored exams; candidates buy remotely.

why_ai: Macro calculation and preference-constrained meal plans are exactly what AI generates on demand.
why_clarity: Macro targets and meal plans are exact, though adherence results show over weeks.
why_digital: Preferences and targets in, PDF and app meal plans out.

why_ai: Internal churn and recommendation modelling is analytics AI tooling increasingly automates.
why_clarity: Churn and engagement models are scored against subscription outcomes each billing cycle.
why_digital: Workout telemetry in, models and dashboards out.

why_ai: Competitors pay for a known coach's judgment on individual response through risky depletion protocols.
why_clarity: Protocols are partly algorithmic, but coaches apply them from memory and stage judging is subjective.
why_digital: Weigh-ins and physique photos in, plans by WhatsApp; remote coaching is normal.

why_ai: Causal ROI claims on HIPAA-protected claims data need judgment, though reporting automates.
why_clarity: Participation is measurable, but claims impact shows only across benefit years.
why_digital: Screening, engagement and claims data in, evaluation reports out to employers.

why_ai: On-site group classes and employer relationships depend on an instructor physically present.
why_clarity: Sessions recur under contract, but wellness outcomes are vague and slow.
why_digital: Mostly on-site classes and assessments, with some virtual sessions and B2B contracting.

why_ai: Aggregated textbook content is substitutable by AI, though curriculum adoption gives brand trust.
why_clarity: Content quality is editorial judgment, with no quick check of correctness.
why_digital: Literature in, textbooks and course content out, some still in print.

why_ai: Network contracts between plans and gyms persist, but utilisation reporting is automatable analytics.
why_clarity: Monthly reimbursement and utilisation reporting repeat on structured visit data.
why_digital: Visit and eligibility data in, payments and reports out, sold to payers.

why_ai: Thin self-selected survey panels give little moat against AI-generated industry summaries.
why_clarity: Annual reports of defined metrics, with sample accuracy never verified.
why_digital: Survey data in, published reports out.

why_ai: Regulated insurers price on unique injury claims data, though small-programme underwriting automates.
why_clarity: Pricing and selection follow actuarial methods, but claims develop over years.
why_digital: Applications and claims data in, policies out, sold through brokers and online.

why_ai: Multi-decade cohorts linking measured fitness to mortality are an irreplaceable dataset AI cannot recreate.
why_clarity: Protocols and norm tables are exact, but health outcomes arrive decades later.
why_digital: Built from physical fitness testing of cohorts, published as digital norms.

why_ai: In-product benchmarks and dashboards over booking data are routine analytics AI produces.
why_clarity: Continuous booking data gives defined metrics recomputed and checked constantly.
why_digital: Booking and payment records in, dashboards out.

why_ai: Sessions happen in clients' homes and parks with portable equipment, a personal hands-on service.
why_clarity: Recurring sessions with measurable progress, but each home and client differs.
why_digital: Trainer travels to the body and the home; bookings arrive by local text.

why_ai: Remote programming and check-ins are what AI coaching apps deliver, leaving mostly personal brand.
why_clarity: Many similar check-ins and programmes, with progress visible over weeks.
why_digital: Photos and check-ins in, app programming out, sold remotely via social media.

why_ai: Sensitive in-person symptom assessment and a trusted relationship drive the service.
why_clarity: Progression and contraindication protocols exist, but recovery varies by individual.
why_digital: Mostly in-person training of new mothers, with some remote programming.

why_ai: Pack decrement, expiry and rebooking rules are exactly what scheduling software automates.
why_clarity: Deterministic rules, every session identical, errors visible immediately.
why_digital: Screen-based admin attached to an in-person service business.

why_ai: Embedded sports scientists interpret load data with coaches, but dashboards and risk models automate.
why_clarity: Load and readiness metrics recur daily, but injury outcomes are noisy and slow.
why_digital: Sensor data from athletes in, dashboards out, sold through team relationships.

why_ai: LLMs increasingly extract and summarise supplement literature, though graded credibility still sells.
why_clarity: Evidence grading follows codified methods, but contradictory small studies leave answers unsettled.
why_digital: Primary literature in, online monographs out by subscription.

why_ai: Monthly studio benchmarks from membership data are routine reporting software generates.
why_clarity: The same studio metrics are reported every month from structured records.
why_digital: Membership records in, benchmark reports out.

why_ai: Proprietary physiological time series sustain the subscription, but scoring itself is machine work.
why_clarity: Daily scores at huge volume, but readiness has no objective ground truth.
why_digital: Wearable signals in, app scores out, sold online.
